text:
Altoona Curve claims 9-4 MiLB victory with Brannigan contributing 2 hits
On Tuesday, June 23, at 6 p.m., the Altoona Curve, featuring former Marist High School standout Jack Brannigan, earned a 9-4 win over the Reading Fightin Phils in their MiLB matchup.
The contest was played at Peoples Natural Gas Field and marked the first time these teams have faced each other this season.
Brannigan finished 2-for-4 at the plate, tallied 2 runs, notched 1 RBI, struck out twice and stranded 2 runners.
The Curve will play again on Wednesday, June 24, at Peoples Natural Gas Field against the Altoona Curve.
